Definition: from G1303; properly, a disposition, i.e. (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will):--covenant, testament.
BiblicalUsage: A covenant is a binding promise, and the word carries the whole Bible from Abraham to the cross. God makes a covenant with Abraham, the blood of the new covenant is shed for many, and Christ is the mediator of a better covenant, established on better promises.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the covenant is the spine of Scripture. Every promise God makes is kept in Christ, and the new covenant is not a new idea but the old promise come to its fullness in His blood.
